wiki.title: Sandscale Water-seeker
wiki.text:
The Sandscale Water-seeker is an enemy manguana NPC that can be found in the Sandscale Oasis dungeon, located in Sunstone Valley. Most water-seekers can heal sandscale scavengers when they are knocked out.

Sandscale Oasis
